match as string: 400 {"code":400,"message":"parsing body body from \"\" failed, because json: cannot unmarshal string into Go struct field BatchDelete.match of type models.BatchDeleteMatch"} — 对照：类型错误正确 400
match as array: 400 {"code":400,"message":"parsing body ... cannot unmarshal array into Go struct field BatchDelete.match of type models.BatchDeleteMatch"} — 对照：正确 400
